title: Whistleblowing Channel Clock Checker
description: Pure calendar-clock arithmetic for a whistleblowing channel over caller-declared synthetic inputs. Checks the declared acknowledgement date against the 7-calendar-day acknowledgement deadline of Directive (EU) 2019/1937 Art 9(1)(b), and computes the follow-up due date as receipt plus a caller-declared whole-day basis (the spec pins the declared basis at 90 days, the Directive's Art 9(1)(f) three-month ceiling as declared days). Pure integer civil-day arithmetic -- no Date object, no runtime clock. No report register, no case feed, no network.

report_received.description: Declared report receipt date, YYYY-MM-DD; both clocks run from this date, never from the clock.

ack_sent.description: Declared acknowledgement date, YYYY-MM-DD; checked against the 7-day window and must not precede report_received.

followup_basis_days.description: Declared follow-up basis in whole civil days (spec pins 90, the Art 9(1)(f) three-month ceiling as declared days); fractional bases are refused, never rounded.

ack_days.description: Civil days from report receipt to acknowledgement; null on the fail-closed path.

ack_within_7.description: True when ack_days <= 7 (Dir 2019/1937 Art 9(1)(b)); null on the fail-closed path.

followup_due.description: Follow-up due date, receipt + basis civil days, YYYY-MM-DD; null on the fail-closed path.

trace.description: The two clock clauses, or the fail-closed reasons naming each rejected input.

overall.description: CLOCKS_COMPLIANT, ACK_WINDOW_BREACHED, or INPUT_REFUSED on the fail-closed path.

mcp_tool_definition.name: compute_whistleblowing_channel_clock
mcp_tool_definition.description: Checks a declared whistleblowing-channel acknowledgement against the 7-calendar-day deadline of Directive (EU) 2019/1937 Art 9(1)(b) and computes the follow-up due date as declared receipt plus a caller-declared whole-day basis (Art 9(1)(f) ceiling as declared days). Clock checker over caller-declared synthetic dates only: no report register, no case feed, no investigation state, not legal advice. Absent or invalid inputs are refused fail-closed and named, never silently repaired.

followup_basis_days.description: declared follow-up basis in whole civil days

source: authored by WHISTLEBLOW-CLOCK-BUILD-1 per WHISTLEBLOW-CLOCK-BUILD-SPEC.md. Scope positioning: a clock checker of declared inputs under named rules (Dir (EU) 2019/1937 Art 9(1)(b)/(f); AI Act extension Reg (EU) 2024/1689 Art 87 as a dated informational note), not a case manager, not an assessment of any report, not legal advice; absent or invalid inputs are refused fail-closed and named, never silently repaired.
